essence: The ritual design begins with a ten-cornered figure made above with half measure.
One should cause Manonmanī to be made above that using half its measure.
The eight Vidyeśvaras should be placed outside in the same manner, or made of gold.
The best teacher should have the performer give them to devotees of Śiva.
The square earth model should be made with a thousand units of gold.
